title: Rebuilding dist/ under a running unpacked extension silently kills content-script injection — reload the SW before re-verifying; SPA mocks may need a click before a <video> exists
trigger: Live verification shows zero Cell elements (no #cell-subtitle-root, no universal-panel host) on a page where the extension previously mounted — page has <video> + <track> but nothing injects
principle: An unpacked extension's content-script loader is pinned to hashed filenames captured at load. Running `npm run build`/`test:e2e:build` overwrites dist/ with new hashes; the running extension then injects a loader pointing at deleted files and fails silently — no error in the page, just absence. Fix is not a code change: attach CDP to the `service_worker` target matching the extension id and `chrome.runtime.reload()`, then reload/navigate the page. Second trap on SPA mocks: the overlay only inits once `findLargestPlayableVideo` sees a rendered <video>; mock-youtube's home page has none — the watch view must be opened first (click `[class*=videoCard]`, wait readyState>=1).

cases.context: Split-view responsive verify: StreamFlix worked, YouTube mock showed video:true + track[blob:] but root:false and cellEls:0 on BOTH mocks after an intervening `npm run test:e2e:build` rebuilt dist/.
cases.bad: Assume the mock or detection pipeline is broken; start patching pageScanner/subtitleDiscovery for a non-bug.
cases.good: Check `document.querySelectorAll('[id^=cell-]').length === 0` → injection dead → CDP `/json` → find `service_worker` target `chrome-extension://<id>/service-worker-loader.js` → `Runtime.evaluate` `chrome.runtime.reload()` → sleep → re-navigate → on the youtube mock click `[class*=videoCard]` before waiting for `#cell-subtitle-root`.

applyFor: live Brave/CDP verification after any dist rebuild
any 'extension suddenly does nothing' on a page it used to instrument
mock-youtube / other SPA mock pages without an initial <video>
